notes.title: We are looking for translators
notes.content:
[h3]We are looking for skilled translators or native speakers to help localize our game [b]Thot on Trial[/b].  [/h3][p][/p][p][b]Target Languages:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Russian [/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese [/p][/*][*][p]Italian [/p][/*][*][p]Spanish [/p][/*][*][p]Polish  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Details:[/b] [/p][p]More than one translator will be assigned to each language to ensure accuracy, speed, and quality.  
Translators will work using our new platform created for translating games.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]How to Apply:[/b] [/p][p]Send your information (experience, availability, and rates) to [u]inceton.jobs@gmail.com[/u] with the subject line "Thot on Trial Translations"[/p][p][/p][p][b]NOTE:[/b] 
The translation applications have to be submitted by this Sunday (August 31, 2025)[/p]
